title: Data Types
description: Overview and deep-dives into all SQL Server data types including character strings, numeric types, date and time types, and special types.
longDescription: This module covers all SQL Server data types in detail. You'll learn about character string types, numeric types, date and time types, and special types like BIT and DATETIMEOFFSET.
whatYouLearn: Understand the SQL Server data type system overview
Use CHAR and VARCHAR for character string storage
Use NCHAR and NVARCHAR for Unicode character storage
Use integer types (BIGINT, INT, SMALLINT, TINYINT) appropriately
Use DECIMAL for exact numeric values
Use DATE, TIME, DATETIME2, and DATETIMEOFFSET for temporal data
